This week in Congress, I introduced the Tax Dollar Accountability Act. 

It’s simple: any state, local, or municipal entity that receives federal funding will have to submit to an AUTOMATIC ANNUAL AUDIT.

I am in the arena fighting to protect your tax dollars from fraud and abuse. As Governor, I’ll continue the work to DOGE Florida and eliminate fraud in our great state.
